title: शततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 100 · Ninth day: Arjuna and the Trigartas

summary.en: Arjuna sends Susharman's Trigarta warriors to Yama's house with his arrows, while Abhimanyu fights Chitrasena. The Pandavas surround Bhishma, who is shielded by Krishna's friends and Arjuna's attack.
summary.kn: ಅರ್ಜುನ ಸುಶರ್ಮನ ತ್ರಿಗರ್ತ ಯೋಧರನ್ನು ಬಾಣಗಳಿಂದ ಯಮನ ಮನೆಗೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯು ಚಿತ್ರಸೇನನೊಡನೆ ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಪಾಂಡವರು ಭೀಷ್ಮನನ್ನು ಸುತ್ತುವರಿಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: अर्जुन सुशर्मा के त्रिगर्त योद्धाओं को बाणों से यमलोक भेजते हैं, जबकि अभिमन्यु चित्रसेन से लड़ता है। पाण्डव भीष्म को घेर लेते हैं।
summary.te: అర్జునుడు సుశర్మ త్రిగర్త యోధులను బాణాలతో యమలోకానికి పంపుతాడు; అభిమన్యుడు చిత్రసేనునితో పోరాడతాడు. పాండవులు భీష్ముని చుట్టుముడతారు.
summary.ta: அர்ஜுனன் சுசர்மனின் திரிகர்த்த வீரர்களை அம்புகளால் யமபுரிக்கு அனுப்புகிறான்; அபிமன்யு சித்ரசேனனுடன் போரிடுகிறான். பாண்டவர் பீஷ்மரைச் சூழ்கின்றனர்.
summary.ml: സുശർമാവിന്റെ ത്രിഗർത്ത യോദ്ധാക്കളെ അർജുനൻ അമ്പുകൾകൊണ്ട് യമന്റെ ഭവനത്തിലേക്ക് അയയ്ക്കുന്നു; അതേസമയം അഭിമന്യു ചിത്രസേനനോട് പൊരുതുന്നു. കൃഷ്ണന്റെ സുഹൃത്തുക്കളും അർജുനന്റെ ആക്രമണവും കവചമായ ഭീഷ്മരെ പാണ്ഡവർ വളയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 6.100; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 26 2021

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
अर्जुनस्तु नरव्याघ्र सुशर्मप्रमुखान्नृपान् ।
अनयत्प्रेतराजस्य भवनं सायकैः शितैः ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna, tiger among men, with his sharp arrows sent the kings led by Susharman to the abode of the king of the dead.

verses.text:
सुशर्मापि ततो बाणैः पार्थं विव्याध संयुगे ।
वासुदेवं च सप्तत्या पार्थं च नवभिः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: Susharman then struck Partha in the battle with arrows, Vasudeva with seventy, and Partha again with nine.

verses.text:
तान्निवार्य शरौघेण शक्रसूनुर्महारथः ।
सुशर्मणो रणे योधान्प्राहिणोद्यमसादनम् ॥

meaning.en: Beating them back with a flood of arrows, Indra's son, the great chariot-warrior, sent Susharman's warriors to Yama's abode.

verses.text:
ते वध्यमानाः पार्थेन कालेनेव युगक्षये ।
व्यद्रवन्त रणे राजन्भये जाते महारथाः ॥

meaning.en: Struck down by Partha as by Time at the end of an age, those great chariot-warriors, seized by fear, fled from the battle, O king.

verses.text:
उत्सृज्य तुरगान्केचिद्रथान्केचिच्च मारिष ।
गजानन्ये समुत्सृज्य प्राद्रवन्त दिशो दश ॥

meaning.en: Some abandoned horses, some chariots, and others elephants, and ran off in the ten directions, my lord.

verses.text:
अपरे तुद्यमानास्तु वाजिनागरथा रणात् ।
त्वरया परया युक्ताः प्राद्रवन्त विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Others, with horses, elephants, and chariots, though hard pressed, fled the field in great haste, lord of the people.

verses.text:
पादाताश्चापि शस्त्राणि समुत्सृज्य महारणे ।
निरपेक्षा व्यधावन्त तेन तेन स्म भारत ॥

meaning.en: Foot-soldiers also threw away their weapons in the great battle and ran heedlessly this way and that, Bharata.

verses.text:
वार्यमाणाः स्म बहुशस्त्रैगर्तेन सुशर्मणा ।
तथान्यैः पार्थिवश्रेष्ठैर्न व्यतिष्ठन्त संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: Though the Trigarta king Susharman and other best of kings often tried to stop them, they would not stand in the fight.

verses.text:
तद्बलं प्रद्रुतं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव ।
पुरस्कृत्य रणे भीष्मं सर्वसैन्यपुरस्कृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that army in flight, your son Duryodhana, putting Bhishma at the head of all the army in the battle,

verses.text:
सर्वोद्योगेन महता धनंजयमुपाद्रवत् ।
त्रिगर्ताधिपतेरर्थे जीवितस्य विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: rushed at Dhananjaya with all his might to save the life of the lord of the Trigartas, lord of the people.

verses.text:
स एकः समरे तस्थौ किरन्बहुविधाञ्शरान् ।
भ्रातृभिः सहितः सर्वैः शेषा विप्रद्रुता नराः ॥

meaning.en: He stood alone in the battle scattering arrows of many kinds, along with all his brothers; the rest of the men had fled.

verses.text:
तथैव पाण्डवा राजन्सर्वोद्योगेन दंशिताः ।
प्रययुः फल्गुनार्थाय यत्र भीष्मो व्यवस्थितः ॥

meaning.en: In the same way the Pandavas, O king, armoured and making every effort, went for Phalguna's sake to where Bhishma stood.

verses.text:
जानन्तोऽपि रणे शौर्यं घोरं गाण्डीवधन्वनः ।
हाहाकारकृतोत्साहा भीष्मं जग्मुः समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Though they knew the terrible prowess of the wielder of the Gandiva bow, they went around Bhishma on every side, with a cry of "Alas!" as their spirit.

verses.text:
ततस्तालध्वजः शूरः पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम् ।
छादयामास समरे शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhishma, whose banner bore a palm tree, the hero, covered the Pandava army in the battle with bent-jointed arrows.

verses.text:
एकीभूतास्ततः सर्वे कुरवः पाण्डवैः सह ।
अयुध्यन्त महाराज मध्यं प्राप्ते दिवाकरे ॥

meaning.en: Then all the Kurus together fought with the Pandavas, great king, when the sun had reached the middle of the sky.

verses.text:
सात्यकिः कृतवर्माणं विद्ध्वा पञ्चभिरायसैः ।
अतिष्ठदाहवे शूरः किरन्बाणान्सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Satyaki pierced Kritavarman with five iron arrows and stood in the battle, the hero, scattering arrows by the thousand.

verses.text:
तथैव द्रुपदो राजा द्रोणं विद्ध्वा शितैः शरैः ।
पुनर्विव्याध सप्तत्या सारथिं चास्य सप्तभिः ॥

meaning.en: Likewise King Drupada pierced Drona with sharp arrows and again with seventy, and his charioteer with seven.

verses.text:
भीमसेनस्तु राजानं बाह्लिकं प्रपितामहम् ।
विद्ध्वानदन्महानादं शार्दूल इव कानने ॥

meaning.en: Bhimasena pierced King Bahlika, the great-grandsire, and roared a mighty roar like a tiger in a forest.

verses.text:
आर्जुनिश्चित्रसेनेन विद्धो बहुभिराशुगैः ।
चित्रसेनं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्विव्याध हृदये भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna's son, pierced by Chitrasena with many swift arrows, struck Chitrasena hard in the heart with three arrows.

verses.text:
समागतौ तौ तु रणे महामात्रौ व्यरोचताम् ।
यथा दिवि महाघोरौ राजन्बुधशनैश्चरौ ॥

meaning.en: Those two great ones, met in the battle, shone, O king, like Mercury and Saturn, so terrible, in the sky.

verses.text:
तस्याश्वांश्चतुरो हत्वा सूतं च नवभिः शरैः ।
ननाद बलवन्नादं सौभद्रः परवीरहा ॥

meaning.en: Killing Chitrasena's four horses and his charioteer with nine arrows, Saubhadra, slayer of enemy heroes, gave a mighty roar.

verses.text:
हताश्वात्तु रथात्तूर्णमवप्लुत्य महारथः ।
आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं दुर्मुखस्य विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Then Chitrasena, the great chariot-warrior, leapt from his chariot whose horses were slain and quickly mounted Durmukha's chariot, lord of the people.

verses.text:
द्रोणश्च द्रुपदं विद्ध्वा शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ।
सारथिं चास्य विव्याध त्वरमाणः पराक्रमी ॥

meaning.en: Drona, piercing Drupada with bent-jointed arrows, quickly and valiantly also pierced his charioteer.

verses.text:
पीड्यमानस्ततो राजा द्रुपदो वाहिनीमुखे ।
अपायाज्जवनैरश्वैः पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन् ॥

meaning.en: Hard pressed at the head of the army, King Drupada withdrew on swift horses, remembering their old enmity.

verses.text:
भीमसेनस्तु राजानं मुहूर्तादिव बाह्लिकम् ।
व्यश्वसूतरथं चक्रे सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Bhimasena, in a moment, left King Bahlika without horses, charioteer, or chariot, while the whole army looked on.

verses.text:
ससंभ्रमो महाराज संशयं परमं गतः ।
अवप्लुत्य ततो वाहाद्बाह्लिकः पुरुषोत्तमः ।
आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं लक्ष्मणस्य महारथः ॥

meaning.en: Bewildered, great king, in utmost peril, that best of men, the great chariot-warrior Bahlika, leapt down from his car and quickly mounted the chariot of Lakshmana.

verses.text:
सात्यकिः कृतवर्माणं वारयित्वा महारथः ।
शरैर्बहुविधै राजन्नाससाद पितामहम् ॥

meaning.en: The great chariot-warrior Satyaki, having held back Kritavarman, came with arrows of many kinds against the grandsire, O king.

verses.text:
स विद्ध्वा भारतं षष्ट्या निशितैर्लोमवाहिभिः ।
ननर्तेव रथोपस्थे विधुन्वानो महद्धनुः ॥

meaning.en: Piercing that Bharata with sixty sharp arrows feathered with hair, he seemed to dance on his chariot-seat, shaking his great bow.

verses.text:
तस्यायसीं महाशक्तिं चिक्षेपाथ पितामहः ।
हेमचित्रां महावेगां नागकन्योपमां शुभाम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the grandsire hurled at him an iron spear, painted with gold, of great speed, beautiful, like a serpent maiden.

verses.text:
तामापतन्तीं सहसा मृत्युकल्पां सुतेजनाम् ।
ध्वंसयामास वार्ष्णेयो लाघवेन महायशाः ॥

meaning.en: As it flew suddenly at him, deadly like Death and very bright, the very famous Vrishni Satyaki destroyed it with his skill.

verses.text:
अनासाद्य तु वार्ष्णेयं शक्तिः परमदारुणा ।
न्यपतद्धरणीपृष्ठे महोल्केव गतप्रभा ॥

meaning.en: Failing to reach the Vrishni, that exceedingly fearful spear fell on the ground, its radiance gone like a great meteor.

verses.text:
वार्ष्णेयस्तु ततो राजन्स्वां शक्तिं घोरदर्शनाम् ।
वेगवद्गृह्य चिक्षेप पितामहरथं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Then, O king, the Vrishni seized his own fearsome-looking spear and hurled it with force at the grandsire's chariot.

verses.text:
वार्ष्णेयभुजवेगेन प्रणुन्ना सा महाहवे ।
अभिदुद्राव वेगेन कालरात्रिर्यथा नरम् ॥

meaning.en: Driven by the force of the Vrishni's arm in the great battle, it ran at him swiftly like the night of doom after a man.

verses.text:
तामापतन्तीं सहसा द्विधा चिच्छेद भारत ।
क्षुरप्राभ्यां सुतीक्ष्णाभ्यां सान्वकीर्यत भूतले ॥

meaning.en: As it came suddenly on, Bharata, he cut it in two with two very sharp razor-headed arrows, and it lay scattered on the ground.

verses.text:
छित्त्वा तु शक्तिं गाङ्गेयः सात्यकिं नवभिः शरैः ।
आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धः प्रहसञ्शत्रुकर्शनः ॥

meaning.en: Having cut the spear, the son of Ganga, tormentor of foes, angry and laughing, struck Satyaki in the chest with nine arrows.

verses.text:
ततः सरथनागाश्वाः पाण्डवाः पाण्डुपूर्वज ।
परिवव्रू रणे भीष्मं माधवत्राणकारणात् ॥

meaning.en: Then, elder brother of Pandu, the Pandavas with chariots, elephants, and horses surrounded Bhishma in the battle to save Madhava Satyaki.

verses.text:
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम् ।
पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च समरे विजयैषिणाम् ॥

meaning.en: Then a tumultuous, hair-raising battle began between the Pandavas and the Kurus, each eager for victory.
